<style>:root{
--ds-a1:#e2542a; --ds-a2:#bf3a11;
--ds-btn-g1:#c9421b; --ds-btn-g2:#a8330f;
--ds-accent:#d4491f;
--ds-accent-ink:#9a3412;
--ds-accent-wash:#fff4f0;
--ds-accent-line:#f6d5c8;
--ds-bg:#ffffff;
--ds-surface:#f7f8fa;
--ds-surface-2:#eff1f5;
--ds-line:#e6e8ee;
--ds-line-2:#d7dae3;
--ds-mut:#63676f;
--ds-ink-2:#3a3d45;
--ds-ink:#0d0f13;
--ds-on-accent:#ffffff;
--ds-ok:#15803d; --ds-ok-wash:#f0fdf4; --ds-ok-line:#bbf7d0;
--ds-warn:#a16207; --ds-warn-wash:#fefce8; --ds-warn-line:#fde68a;
--ds-bad:#b91c1c; --ds-bad-wash:#fef2f2; --ds-bad-line:#fecaca;
--ds-f-11:11px; --ds-f-13:13px; --ds-f-15:15px;
--ds-f-18:18px; --ds-f-24:24px; --ds-f-32:32px;
--ds-lh-body:1.5; --ds-lh-head:1.15;
--ds-track-tight:-0.01em;
--ds-track-label:0.04em;
--ds-s1:4px; --ds-s2:8px; --ds-s3:12px; --ds-s4:16px; --ds-s5:24px; --ds-s6:32px;
--ds-r:12px; --ds-r-sm:10px; --ds-r-lg:14px; --ds-r-pill:999px;
--ds-sh-1:0 1px 2px rgba(13,15,19,.05);
--ds-sh-2:0 1px 2px rgba(13,15,19,.04), 0 8px 24px -14px rgba(13,15,19,.22);
--ds-sh-3:0 1px 3px rgba(13,15,19,.06), 0 18px 40px -20px rgba(13,15,19,.28);
--ds-glow:0 8px 20px -8px rgba(191,58,17,.55);
--ds-ring:0 0 0 3px rgba(212,73,31,.22);
--ds-ease:140ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
--ds-ease-slow:220ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
--ds-font:ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Inter,Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
--ds-mono:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,"SF Mono",Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
*{margin:0;padding:0}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
font-family:var(--ds-font);
font-size:var(--ds-f-15);
line-height:var(--ds-lh-body);
color:var(--ds-ink-2);
background:var(--ds-bg);
-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
-moz-osx-font-smoothing:grayscale;
font-synthesis-weight:none;
}
img,svg,video{max-width:100%;display:block}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit;color:inherit}
h1,h2,h3,h4{color:var(--ds-ink);line-height:var(--ds-lh-head);letter-spacing:var(--ds-track-tight);font-weight:800}
h1{font-size:var(--ds-f-32)}
h2{font-size:var(--ds-f-24)}
h3{font-size:var(--ds-f-18)}
h4{font-size:var(--ds-f-15);letter-spacing:normal}
p{line-height:var(--ds-lh-body)}
strong,b{font-weight:700;color:var(--ds-ink)}
hr{border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--ds-line)}
:where(a,button,input,select,textarea,summary,label[for],[tabindex]):focus-visible{
outline:2px solid var(--ds-accent);
outline-offset:2px;
border-radius:var(--ds-r-sm);
}
::selection{background:var(--ds-accent-wash);color:var(--ds-accent-ink)}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
html{scroll-behavior:auto}
*,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.001ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;transition-duration:.001ms!important}
}
.ds-t11{font-size:var(--ds-f-11)} .ds-t13{font-size:var(--ds-f-13)}
.ds-t15{font-size:var(--ds-f-15)} .ds-t18{font-size:var(--ds-f-18)}
.ds-t24{font-size:var(--ds-f-24)} .ds-t32{font-size:var(--ds-f-32)}
.ds-mut{color:var(--ds-mut)}
.ds-ink{color:var(--ds-ink)}
.ds-eyebrow{
display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--ds-s2);
font-size:var(--ds-f-11);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;
letter-spacing:var(--ds-track-label);color:var(--ds-mut);
}
.ds-eyebrow .ds-dot{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ds-accent);flex:none}
.ds-stack{display:grid;gap:var(--ds-s3)}
.ds-stack-4{display:grid;gap:var(--ds-s4)}
.ds-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--ds-s3);flex-wrap:wrap}
.ds-divider{height:1px;background:var(--ds-line);border:0;margin:var(--ds-s5) 0}
.ds-mark{
width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:10px;flex:none;
display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--ds-a1),var(--ds-a2));
box-shadow:0 4px 12px -4px rgba(191,58,17,.5);
color:var(--ds-on-accent);
}
.ds-mark svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.ds-mark.lg{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:13px}
.ds-mark.lg svg{width:23px;height:23px}
.ds-mark.sm{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:8px}
.ds-mark.sm svg{width:15px;height:15px}
.ds-brand{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--ds-s3);color:var(--ds-ink)}
.ds-brand b{font-size:var(--ds-f-18);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.1}
.ds-brand small{display:block;font-size:var(--ds-f-11);font-weight:500;color:var(--ds-mut);letter-spacing:0}
.ds-btn{
display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:var(--ds-s2);
min-height:44px;padding:0 var(--ds-s5);
border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--ds-r-sm);
font-size:var(--ds-f-15);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.005em;
cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;text-align:center;
background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--ds-btn-g1),var(--ds-btn-g2));
color:var(--ds-on-accent);
box-shadow:var(--ds-glow);
transition:transform var(--ds-ease),box-shadow var(--ds-ease),background-color var(--ds-ease),border-color var(--ds-ease),color var(--ds-ease);
}
.ds-btn svg{width:17px;height:17px;flex:none}
.ds-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 12px 26px -8px rgba(191,58,17,.6)}
.ds-btn:active{transform:translateY(0);box-shadow:var(--ds-sh-1)}
.ds-btn[disabled],.ds-btn[aria-disabled="true"]{opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed;transform:none;box-shadow:none}
.ds-btn.ghost{background:var(--ds-bg);color:var(--ds-ink);border-color:var(--ds-line-2);box-shadow:var(--ds-sh-1)}
.ds-btn.ghost:hover{border-color:var(--ds-ink);box-shadow:var(--ds-sh-2)}
.ds-btn.quiet{background:transparent;color:var(--ds-mut);border-color:transparent;box-shadow:none;font-weight:600;padding:0 var(--ds-s3)}
.ds-btn.quiet:hover{color:var(--ds-ink);background:var(--ds-surface);transform:none;box-shadow:none}
.ds-btn.sm{min-height:34px;padding:0 var(--ds-s4);font-size:var(--ds-f-13)}
.ds-btn.lg{min-height:52px;padding:0 var(--ds-s6);font-size:var(--ds-f-18)}
.ds-btn.block{width:100%}
.ds-link{
display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
font-size:var(--ds-f-13);font-weight:700;color:var(--ds-accent-ink);
transition:gap var(--ds-ease),color var(--ds-ease);
}
.ds-link svg{width:14px;height:14px}
.ds-link:hover{gap:9px;color:var(--ds-ink)}
.ds-card{
background:var(--ds-bg);
border:1px solid var(--ds-line);
border-radius:var(--ds-r);
box-shadow:var(--ds-sh-1);
transition:transform var(--ds-ease),border-color var(--ds-ease),box-shadow var(--ds-ease);
}
.ds-card.pad{padding:var(--ds-s5)}
.ds-card.quiet{background:var(--ds-surface);box-shadow:none}
a.ds-card:hover,.ds-card.hoverable:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:var(--ds-line-2);box-shadow:var(--ds-sh-2)}
.ds-card.feature{border-color:var(--ds-accent-line);box-shadow:var(--ds-sh-2)}
.ds-chip{
width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:10px;flex:none;
display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
background:var(--ds-surface);border:1px solid var(--ds-line);color:var(--ds-ink-2);
transition:background-color var(--ds-ease),color var(--ds-ease),border-color var(--ds-ease);
}
.ds-chip svg{width:19px;height:19px}
.ds-chip.accent{background:var(--ds-accent-wash);border-color:var(--ds-accent-line);color:var(--ds-accent-ink)}
a:hover .ds-chip,.ds-card:hover .ds-chip{background:var(--ds-accent-wash);border-color:var(--ds-accent-line);color:var(--ds-accent-ink)}
.ds-badge{
display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;
font-size:var(--ds-f-11);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.03em;
padding:3px 9px;border-radius:var(--ds-r-pill);
background:var(--ds-surface);border:1px solid var(--ds-line);color:var(--ds-ink-2);
white-space:nowrap;
}
.ds-badge svg{width:12px;height:12px}
.ds-badge.accent{background:var(--ds-accent-wash);border-color:var(--ds-accent-line);color:var(--ds-accent-ink)}
.ds-badge.ok{background:var(--ds-ok-wash);border-color:var(--ds-ok-line);color:var(--ds-ok)}
.ds-badge.warn{background:var(--ds-warn-wash);border-color:var(--ds-warn-line);color:var(--ds-warn)}
.ds-badge.bad{background:var(--ds-bad-wash);border-color:var(--ds-bad-line);color:var(--ds-bad)}
.ds-badge.solid{background:var(--ds-ink);border-color:var(--ds-ink);color:#fff}
.ds-label{
display:block;font-size:var(--ds-f-11);font-weight:700;color:var(--ds-mut);
text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:var(--ds-track-label);margin-bottom:6px;
}
.ds-input,.ds-select,.ds-textarea{
width:100%;min-height:44px;padding:10px var(--ds-s4);
background:var(--ds-bg);border:1px solid var(--ds-line-2);border-radius:var(--ds-r-sm);
color:var(--ds-ink);font-size:var(--ds-f-15);
transition:border-color var(--ds-ease),box-shadow var(--ds-ease);
}
.ds-input::placeholder,.ds-textarea::placeholder{color:#8b8f98}
.ds-input:hover,.ds-select:hover,.ds-textarea:hover{border-color:var(--ds-line-2)}
.ds-input:focus,.ds-select:focus,.ds-textarea:focus{
outline:none;border-color:var(--ds-accent);box-shadow:var(--ds-ring);
}
.ds-input[aria-invalid="true"]{border-color:var(--ds-bad);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(185,28,28,.14)}
.ds-textarea{min-height:96px;resize:vertical;padding-top:var(--ds-s3)}
.ds-select{
appearance:none;cursor:pointer;padding-right:38px;
background-image:linear-gradient(45deg,transparent 50%,var(--ds-mut) 50%),linear-gradient(135deg,var(--ds-mut) 50%,transparent 50%);
background-position:calc(100% - 19px) center,calc(100% - 14px) center;
background-size:5px 5px,5px 5px;background-repeat:no-repeat;
}
.ds-help{font-size:var(--ds-f-13);color:var(--ds-mut);margin-top:6px}
.ds-tabs{display:flex;gap:var(--ds-s5);border-bottom:1px solid var(--ds-line)}
.ds-tabs a,.ds-tabs button{
background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;
padding:var(--ds-s3) 0;margin-bottom:-1px;
font-size:var(--ds-f-13);font-weight:600;color:var(--ds-mut);
border-bottom:2px solid transparent;
transition:color var(--ds-ease),border-color var(--ds-ease);
}
.ds-tabs a:hover,.ds-tabs button:hover{color:var(--ds-ink)}
.ds-tabs .is-active{color:var(--ds-ink);border-bottom-color:var(--ds-accent);font-weight:700}
.ds-empty{
display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;
gap:var(--ds-s2);padding:var(--ds-s6) var(--ds-s5);
border:1px dashed var(--ds-line-2);border-radius:var(--ds-r);background:var(--ds-surface);
}
.ds-empty svg{width:30px;height:30px;color:var(--ds-line-2);margin-bottom:var(--ds-s1)}
.ds-empty .ds-empty-t{font-size:var(--ds-f-15);font-weight:700;color:var(--ds-ink)}
.ds-empty .ds-empty-s{font-size:var(--ds-f-13);color:var(--ds-mut);max-width:44ch;line-height:1.5}
.ds-empty .ds-btn{margin-top:var(--ds-s2)}
.ds-skel{
background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--ds-surface) 25%,var(--ds-surface-2) 37%,var(--ds-surface) 63%);
background-size:400% 100%;
animation:ds-shimmer 1.4s ease-in-out infinite;
border-radius:var(--ds-r-sm);
}
.ds-skel.line{height:12px;margin-bottom:var(--ds-s2)}
.ds-skel.line.short{width:55%}
.ds-skel.block{height:120px}
@keyframes ds-shimmer{0%{background-position:100% 0}100%{background-position:0 0}}
.ds-loading-note{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--ds-s2);font-size:var(--ds-f-13);color:var(--ds-mut);margin-top:var(--ds-s3)}
.ds-spin{width:14px;height:14px;flex:none;animation:ds-spin 800ms linear infinite}
@keyframes ds-spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.ds-alert{
display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:var(--ds-s3);
padding:var(--ds-s3) var(--ds-s4);border-radius:var(--ds-r-sm);
border:1px solid var(--ds-line);background:var(--ds-surface);
font-size:var(--ds-f-13);line-height:1.5;color:var(--ds-ink-2);text-align:left;
}
.ds-alert svg{width:17px;height:17px;flex:none;margin-top:1px}
.ds-alert b{display:block;font-size:var(--ds-f-13);margin-bottom:2px}
.ds-alert.err{background:var(--ds-bad-wash);border-color:var(--ds-bad-line);color:#7f1d1d}
.ds-alert.err svg,.ds-alert.err b{color:var(--ds-bad)}
.ds-alert.ok{background:var(--ds-ok-wash);border-color:var(--ds-ok-line);color:#14532d}
.ds-alert.ok svg,.ds-alert.ok b{color:var(--ds-ok)}
.ds-alert.warn{background:var(--ds-warn-wash);border-color:var(--ds-warn-line);color:#713f12}
.ds-alert.warn svg,.ds-alert.warn b{color:var(--ds-warn)}
.ds-alert a{color:inherit;font-weight:700;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:2px}
.ds-feats{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:var(--ds-s2)}
.ds-feats li{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:var(--ds-s3);font-size:var(--ds-f-13);color:var(--ds-ink-2);line-height:1.45}
.ds-feats svg{width:16px;height:16px;flex:none;color:var(--ds-accent);margin-top:1px}
.ds-vh{
position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;
overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap;border:0;
}
[data-theme="dark"]{
--ds-bg:#0b0d12; --ds-surface:#12151d; --ds-surface-2:#191d27;
--ds-line:#232836; --ds-line-2:#313848;
--ds-mut:#98a0b0; --ds-ink-2:#c9d0dc; --ds-ink:#f2f5fa;

/* ---- announce -------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* ---- nav ------------------------------------------------------------------
   The old markup wrapped the links in a closed <details>, which Chrome renders
   with content-visibility:hidden — so the ENTIRE desktop navigation measured 0px
   wide and painted nothing at 1440px. Replaced with a CSS-only checkbox
   disclosure: one copy of the links, visible on desktop, collapsible on mobile,
   no JS, no inline handlers (CSP blocks those). ------------------------------ */
.navwrap{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;background:rgba(255,255,255,.82);backdrop-filter:blur(16px) saturate(160%);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px) saturate(160%);border-bottom:1px solid var(--ds-line);transition:box-shadow var(--ds-ease-slow)}

/* ---- hero -----------------------------------------------------------------
   Left-aligned, asymmetric two-column. Centring everything is the fastest way
   to look machine-made; a real page has a reading edge. ---------------------- */

/* ---- search ---------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* ---- sections -------------------------------------------------------------- */
section{padding:var(--ds-s6) 0}
.shead{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:var(--ds-s5);gap:var(--ds-s4)}

.cats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:var(--ds-s3)}

.cat{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:var(--ds-s3);min-height:132px;padding:var(--ds-s4);border-radius:var(--ds-r);background:var(--ds-bg);border:1px solid var(--ds-line);color:var(--ds-ink);box-shadow:var(--ds-sh-1);transition:transform var(--ds-ease),box-shadow var(--ds-ease),border-color var(--ds-ease)}

.cat .ci svg{width:19px;height:19px}
.cat:hover .ci{background:var(--ds-accent-wash);border-color:var(--ds-accent-line);color:var(--ds-accent-ink)}
.cat .cl{font-size:var(--ds-f-15);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.012em;margin-top:auto;color:var(--ds-ink)}
.cat .cb{font-size:var(--ds-f-13);color:var(--ds-mut);font-weight:400;margin-top:2px}
.cat .cn{position:absolute;top:var(--ds-s4);right:var(--ds-s4);font-size:var(--ds-f-11);font-weight:700;background:var(--ds-surface);border:1px solid var(--ds-line);color:var(--ds-mut);padding:3px 9px;border-radius:var(--ds-r-pill)}
.cat.svc .ci{background:var(--ds-accent-wash);border-color:var(--ds-accent-line);color:var(--ds-accent-ink)}

/* ---- product cards ---------------------------------------------------------
   The old cover printed the product title inside a grey box, and the card printed
   it again directly underneath — every card said its own name twice. That single
   duplication is what made the catalogue read as auto-generated. The cover now
   carries the CATEGORY as a faint watermark and nothing else. ----------------- */
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:var(--ds-s4)}
.card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--ds-bg);border:1px solid var(--ds-line);border-radius:var(--ds-r);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--ds-sh-1);transition:transform var(--ds-ease),border-color var(--ds-ease),box-shadow var(--ds-ease)}

.card:hover .thumb.tcover svg{color:#b9bec9;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.cbody{padding:var(--ds-s4);display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex:1;gap:6px}
.card .tag{align-self:flex-start;font-size:var(--ds-f-11);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:var(--ds-track-label);color:var(--ds-mut);background:var(--ds-surface);border:1px solid var(--ds-line);padding:3px 8px;border-radius:var(--ds-r-pill)}

.btn-buy{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:var(--ds-s2);min-height:52px;padding:0 var(--ds-s6);background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--ds-btn-g1),var(--ds-btn-g2));color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:var(--ds-r-sm);font-weight:700;font-size:var(--ds-f-18);box-shadow:var(--ds-glow);letter-spacing:-.012em;transition:transform var(--ds-ease),box-shadow var(--ds-ease)}

.cat.svc .ci{background:var(--ds-accent-wash);border-color:var(--ds-accent-line);color:var(--ds-accent-ink)}

/* ---- product cards ---------------------------------------------------------
   The old cover printed the product title inside a grey box, and the card printed
   it again directly underneath — every card said its own name twice. That single
   duplication is what made the catalogue read as auto-generated. The cover now
   carries the CATEGORY as a faint watermark and nothing else. ----------------- */
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:var(--ds-s4)}

.btn-buy{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:var(--ds-s2);min-height:52px;padding:0 var(--ds-s6);background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--ds-btn-g1),var(--ds-btn-g2));color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:var(--ds-r-sm);font-weight:700;font-size:var(--ds-f-18);box-shadow:var(--ds-glow);letter-spacing:-.012em;transition:transform var(--ds-ease),box-shadow var(--ds-ease)}
